page: OVHcloud b3-16-flex is a general-purpose cloud instance provisioned via the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC processor running at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. Compute resources comprise 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with 1 thread per core, backed by 32 KB L1 data cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB shared L3 cache. Memory is allocated at 16.0 GB of RAM, sustaining a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The server includes 50 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage and connects to standard infrastructure with a 1 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Accelerator hardware is absent, with 0 GPUs installed.

Benchmark results reveal strong single-thread efficiency and consistent general-purpose compute metrics. In synthetic CPU testing, the instance achieved a stress-ng single-core score of 3074.47, ranking in the top 25%, alongside an average multi-core output of 12238.53. Geekbench scores registered 1838.0 in single-core and 5965.0 in multi-core routines, with particular strength in text processing workloads (2636.0). PassMark evaluations confirmed solid midrange performance, reporting an overall CPU mark of 10600.44 and database operational throughput of 4105.8 operations. Memory bandwidth tests demonstrated uncached read speeds of 93.53 GB/sec and write speeds of 40.42 GB/sec.

Performance constraints appear primarily in network-dependent serving and large matrix operations due to the absence of AVX-512 extensions and modest baseline bandwidth. Static web serving throughput tested in the lower quartile at 4.82 GB/sec, while larger machine learning tasks such as 7B model prompt processing reached only 20.9 tokens/sec. Conversely, lightweight small-model inference (135M) reached 742.33 tokens/sec for prompt ingestion and 206.32 tokens/sec for generation. Given the dedicated core allocation, fast local NVMe disk, and balanced RAM ratio, b3-16-flex delivers cost-effective operational density for relational databases, Redis caching layers, build runners, text processing pipelines, and general application backends.
description: OVHcloud b3-16-flex is a balanced general-purpose virtual server built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an AMD EPYC processor clocked at 2.3 GHz. The instance is configured with 4 dedicated x86_64 cores, 16.0 GB of system RAM, 50 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage, and a 1 Gbps network baseline. It contains no dedicated GPU hardware. Benchmark data highlights top-quartile single-core CPU execution and solid text processing throughput, backed by steady uncached memory read bandwidth of 93.53 GB/sec and 9.64 million Redis SET operations per second. While static web serving throughput and advanced vector compute show baseline limitations, the dedicated physical cores and NVMe drive provide reliable performance density. The server is well suited for transactional databases, CI/CD compilation, application backends, and caching layers.
